title: ChessPlusPlus Game Configuration
description: Configuration schema for a hex-grid tactics game. Uses axial coordinates (q, r). Matches DEFAULT_CONFIG in server/game/engine/config_loader.py and client config.service.ts.

radius.description: Hex grid radius (distance from centre hex to edge). The default board is radius 11 (12 cells per hexagon edge).

orientation.description: Cosmetic: how the client draws the board hexagon. Default is edge-up.

units.description: Unit type definitions, keyed by unit id.

display.description: Per-colour display glyphs rendered on the board.

move.description: Number of adjacent-hex steps this unit can move per turn. Movement floods outward through the six hex neighbours. A unit walks through its own - an ally costs a step to pass but is not somewhere to stop - while an enemy blocks the hex and the way past it alike.

hp.description: Maximum hit points for this unit type.

attack.description: Attack damage dealt when this unit initiates combat.

commander.description: This unit is the side's commander. Under the 'regicide' objective, losing every commander loses the game. Omitted means false.

attackRange.description: How many rings of adjacency this unit can strike, by hex distance and ignoring obstacles. 1 = the six neighbouring hexes. Beyond the first ring damage falls off by rules.rangeFalloff per extra ring. Omitted means 1.

defense.description: Flat damage reduction applied when this unit is attacked. strike_damage() subtracts it from the incoming attack, floored at 0.

abilities.description: Global ability catalogue, keyed by ability id. PLACEHOLDER: the engine does not read abilities yet.

white.description: Map of 'q,r' coordinate strings to unit type ids for white.

black.description: Map of 'q,r' coordinate strings to unit type ids for black.

turnTimeLimit.description: Per-turn time limit in seconds (0 = unlimited).

rangeFalloff.description: Fraction of attack damage lost per ring beyond the first, applied linearly: ring 2 deals (1 - falloff) of the attack stat, ring 3 (1 - 2*falloff), floored, never below 1.

objective.description: Win condition. 'regicide' (the default): a side loses when it has no commander left. 'elimination': a side loses when it has no units left at all.
